verdict: Purchases have stalled; the 28-day ROAS headline flatters recent performance.
narrative: This period delivered a 5.33x return on ad spend across $1,442.91 in Meta spend and 31 purchases — but that number is carried almost entirely by a strong mid-July spike, and purchases have effectively stopped over the last four days. Instagram reach has also dropped roughly 37% in the most recent three days, pointing to audience saturation on the Muslim Subscription Box campaign. Traffic is still arriving — 6,387 sessions this period — but visitors are not converting, and the subscription funnel is being repaired to close that gap. A creative refresh on the top campaign is already in motion, and the funnel fix is tracked to complete by end of August; you should see purchases restabilise as those two actions take hold.
